title: Adding Text
description: Display text and body text: steer to the baseline, type, and style it from the Text section.

bubble.title: Text is steered, then typed
bubble.body: Choose the text kind first, steer the cursor to where the baseline starts, and type. The text follows the Text section's font settings.

bubble.title: Display or Body
bubble.body: Display Text is a single styled line. Body Text flows inside a frame. Text can also be set on a path, following its curve.

bubble.title: Type on the canvas
bubble.body: With Display Text chosen, steer to the start point and type your headline. Enter finishes the line.

bubble.title: Style it
bubble.body: Family, size, weight and justification are in the Text section. Select existing text first to restyle it.

bubble.title: Text stays editable
bubble.body: Text remains text — editable, restylable, searchable — until you deliberately convert it. It exports as text in SVG and PDF.
